svg.title: Where each solution intervenes in the Synapse deployment pipeline
svg.desc: Seven methods mapped to their intervention point: naming convention and expressions act at authoring time, Terraform templatefile and TF resources act at infrastructure time, workspace sync acts before deployment, ARM rewrite acts on the template, and parameterize-only acts at deploy time.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the expression-based dynamic linked service approach')
sendPrompt('Explain the ARM template rewrite approach')
